_comment: Categories where tax, law or regulation makes advice non-transferable across countries. A creator can be excellent and still be useless to a visitor in the wrong country — five US creators in a category is not coverage for a UK visitor. The owner's instruction: solve this with metadata rather than by multiplying the 5-creator minimum. Creators in these categories carry a `jurisdiction` field; the coverage report names any flagged category with no creator for a major English-speaking market.

values.general: Transfers across countries — no jurisdiction-specific tax, law or regulation involved.

categories.personal-budgeting: Credit systems, benefits and account types differ enough to change the advice.
categories.debt-payoff: Bankruptcy, collections and consumer-protection law are national.
categories.index-fund-investing: Tax wrappers (ISA, TFSA, 401k, RRSP) determine which account to use before which fund.
categories.retirement-planning: Pensions, state provision and withdrawal rules are entirely national.
categories.real-estate-investing: Purchase taxes, mortgage rules, tenancy law and reliefs are all national.
categories.credit-and-loans: Credit scoring and lending regulation differ fundamentally between markets.
categories.insurance-basics: Health, liability and life cover are shaped by national systems.
categories.crypto-literacy: Tax treatment and exchange regulation vary sharply.
categories.salary-negotiation: Pay data, norms and disclosure law are local.
categories.resume-writing: CV conventions, length, photographs and legal restrictions differ by country.
categories.addiction-recovery: Treatment systems, funding and access routes are national.
